title: Development of Exercise Protocol for Scoliosis Using Surface Electromyography(S-EMG)
brief_summary: There has been much effort in recent years to better understand the causes of idiopathic scoliosis (IS). Some studies suggested muscle imbalance as a cause of scoliosis based on asymmetric muscular activation. Surface electromyography can evaluate asymmetrical muscular weakness. Therefore, the peak amplitude values can be used to compare the side to side differences in paraspinal muscles. From these findings the investigators improve the exercise method of IS according to muscle weakness and curve pattern.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* X-ray shows a cobb angle of 10 degrees or higher.
* Patients 8 and older.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with spinal surgery
* Patients with scoliosis caused by cerebral palsy, muscle paralysis, polio, congenital spinal cord abnormalities, etc.
* Cobb angle less than 10 degrees and more than 40 degrees
* Patients with acute back pain
